body:
With this substance my success rate attempting LD through DILDs [Dream-Induced Lucid Dreams] or WILDs [Wake-Induced Lucid Dreams] is 99 percent.
Usually, I take 8 mg in the early morning, after 4-6 hours of sleep. The transitions to LD are very smooth and natural. To avoid desensitization I do no more than 2-3 galantamine attempts per week.
